name: markii-e2e-browser-host
description: Browser host fixture: a Vite app that consumes the PACKED @markii/* tarballs (never workspace links) and the Playwright suite that drives it in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Standalone: not a root workspace, so the root npm test never starts a browser.

scripts.e2e: npm run setup && npm run test:node && npm run build && playwright test
